answer: Require agents to lock a scarce, slashable stake before their votes count. Select committees by stake, not account count, and slash members who sign conflicting results. A thousand fake identities then gain no extra influence; an attacker must acquire and lock real value, risking its loss. A summit decision can use a quartz stake registry, while the ripple of this rule is that Sybil attacks cost capital, though wealthy colluders remain a risk.
